items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: George Benson got a chance to hang around with Herbie Hancock and Freddie Hubbard and Joe Henderson and all those guys

ctx.x: Give us some of the guitar icons.

Well when I came up, the first one like I said the first one I was listening to was Wes Montgomery and then from there I listened to Kenny Burrell and from there there was Pat Martino and then in the 70s I finally got some records by George Benson and I heard him and I said, “Oh, no!” But after a while you go through all the guitar players, there are things that are being done on the instrument and after a while you can say okay, that’s how it’s done. But I’m at a point, I’ve reached the point where I’m…
Do you find yourself when you solo when you play your lines, do you find yourself phrasing like a wind player?
